offend.en: I did not mean to offend anyone with my careless comment.
offend.zh: 我並不是故意要用那句不經意的話冒犯任何人。

offense.en: The coach explained that the team needed a stronger offense.
offense.zh: 教練說明球隊需要更強的進攻。

offensive.en: The website removed an offensive remark from the discussion board.
offensive.zh: 網站從討論區移除了一則冒犯性的留言。

offering.en: The museum is offering free admission to students this weekend.
offering.zh: 這間博物館本週末提供學生免費入場。

officer.en: A school officer helped direct visitors during the open house.
officer.zh: 一位校方人員在開放日時協助引導訪客。

offshore.en: Strong winds affected several offshore islands during the storm.
offshore.zh: 暴風雨期間，強風影響了數座外海島嶼。

offspring.en: The documentary showed how penguins protect their offspring from cold weather.
offspring.zh: 紀錄片展示企鵝如何保護幼鳥免受寒冷天氣影響。

ok.en: It is ok to ask questions when the instructions are unclear.
ok.zh: 當指示不清楚時，提出問題是可以的。

okay.en: She checked whether everyone was okay after the sudden power outage.
okay.zh: 突然停電後，她確認每個人是否都沒事。

olive.en: The salad included tomato, cucumber, and a few slices of olive.
olive.zh: 沙拉裡有番茄、小黃瓜和幾片橄欖。

omit.en: Do not omit your name when submitting the assignment online.
omit.zh: 線上繳交作業時不要漏掉你的名字。

ongoing.en: The ongoing project will continue throughout the school semester.
ongoing.zh: 這項進行中的專題會持續整個學期。

onion.en: She added chopped onion to the soup for extra flavor.
onion.zh: 她在湯裡加入切碎的洋蔥增添風味。

online.en: The teacher posted the reading materials online before class.
online.zh: 老師在上課前把閱讀資料放到網路上。

onto.en: The cat jumped onto the chair beside the window.
onto.zh: 那隻貓跳到窗邊的椅子上。

opera.en: Our music class watched part of a famous opera performance.
opera.zh: 我們音樂課看了一段知名歌劇演出。

operational.en: The new computer lab became fully operational after several tests.
operational.zh: 新電腦教室經過幾次測試後正式投入使用。

operative.en: The key operative word in the rule is clearly defined.
operative.zh: 這項規則中的關鍵用詞已有清楚定義。

operator.en: The machine operator checked the controls before starting the demonstration.
operator.zh: 機器操作員在示範開始前檢查了控制裝置。

oppress.en: The history lesson examined how unfair laws can oppress minority groups.
oppress.zh: 歷史課探討不公平法律如何壓迫少數群體。

oppression.en: The novel explores the effects of oppression on ordinary families.
oppression.zh: 這本小說探討壓迫對一般家庭造成的影響。

opt.en: Students may opt to present their projects in pairs.
opt.zh: 學生可以選擇兩人一組進行專題發表。

optimism.en: Her optimism helped the group stay motivated after several setbacks.
optimism.zh: 她的樂觀讓團隊在幾次挫折後仍保持動力。

optimistic.en: The coach remained optimistic about the team's chances this season.
optimistic.zh: 教練對球隊本季的機會仍保持樂觀。

optional.en: The extra reading is optional but useful for deeper understanding.
optional.zh: 額外閱讀不是必須的，但有助於更深入理解。

oral.en: Each student gave a short oral report in English class.
oral.zh: 每位學生都在英文課做了一段簡短口頭報告。

orbit.en: The satellite entered orbit around Earth after launch.
orbit.zh: 衛星發射後進入繞地球運行的軌道。

orchard.en: The class visited an orchard to learn how fruit is grown.
orchard.zh: 班級參觀果園，了解水果如何栽種。

orchestra.en: The school orchestra performed at the graduation ceremony.
orchestra.zh: 學校管弦樂團在畢業典禮上演出。

ordeal.en: The long delay was an ordeal for travelers at the station.
ordeal.zh: 漫長的延誤對車站裡的旅客來說是一場煎熬。

orderly.en: The volunteers kept the books in an orderly arrangement.
orderly.zh: 志工把書籍整理得井然有序。

organ.en: The heart is an organ that pumps blood through the body.
organ.zh: 心臟是一個將血液送往全身的器官。

organic.en: The science class compared organic material with synthetic material.
organic.zh: 自然科學課比較了有機材料與合成材料。

organism.en: Every organism in the pond depends on its environment.
organism.zh: 池塘裡的每個生物都依賴周遭環境。

organizer.en: The event organizer sent the final schedule to all participants.
organizer.zh: 活動主辦人把最終時程寄給所有參與者。

oriental.en: The museum label explained the historical use of the word oriental.
oriental.zh: 博物館標示說明了 oriental 一詞在歷史上的用法。

orientation.en: New students attended an orientation before the semester began.
orientation.zh: 新生在學期開始前參加了新生說明會。

originality.en: The judges praised the originality of her science project.
originality.zh: 評審稱讚她科展作品的原創性。

orphanage.en: The charity donated books to an orphanage in the region.
orphanage.zh: 慈善團體捐書給該地區的一所孤兒院。

orthodox.en: The article compares an orthodox approach with newer methods.
orthodox.zh: 文章比較傳統做法與較新的方法。

ounce.en: The recipe lists each ingredient by ounce and gram.
ounce.zh: 食譜以盎司和公克列出每種材料。

ours.en: That classroom is theirs, while this one is ours.
ours.zh: 那間教室是他們的，而這間是我們的。

ourselves.en: We prepared ourselves carefully before the final presentation.
ourselves.zh: 我們在最後發表前仔細做好準備。

outbreak.en: The report described how schools responded to a local flu outbreak.
outbreak.zh: 報告描述學校如何因應當地流感疫情。

outdoor.en: The school added an outdoor study area beside the library.
outdoor.zh: 學校在圖書館旁新增一處戶外學習區。

outdoors.en: We spent the afternoon outdoors during the environmental science activity.
outdoors.zh: 環境科學活動時，我們整個下午都待在戶外。

outer.en: The outer layer of the box was damaged during shipping.
outer.zh: 箱子的外層在運送過程中受損。

outfit.en: She chose a simple outfit for the school ceremony.
outfit.zh: 她為學校典禮選了一套簡單的服裝。

outgoing.en: His outgoing personality made it easy to welcome new classmates.
outgoing.zh: 他外向的個性讓他很容易歡迎新同學。

outing.en: The class planned an outing to the science museum.
outing.zh: 班上規劃了一次前往科學博物館的校外活動。
